en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3510 - Sulaiman ibn Dawud Al-Minqari narrated from Abdul Aziz ibn Muhammad, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as), or I heard him say:
"A free woman is not compelled to breastfeed the child, but an Umm al-Walad (a female slave who bore her master a child) is compelled."
